articles.title: Israeli attacks kill six Palestinians in Gaza as ceasefire violations mount
articles.summary: At least six Palestinians have been killed and several others, including children, been injured in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip, medical sources reported amid continued violations of a 2025 ceasefire.

articles.title: Right Livelihood Award honors women taking on autocrats, discrimination and unchecked AI
articles.summary: The Right Livelihood Award has been given to two women and two women-led organizations to recognize work against authoritarianism, violence and AI-related harms

articles.title: Britain’s 'Settlement' Ban: Rewarding rejectionism at Israel’s expense
articles.summary: The relevant question is not simply whether a Palestinian Arab state can be drawn on a map. It is whether Arab leaders are prepared to regard such a state as the conclusion of the conflict rather than another stage in it. Opinion.
